```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
track <- read.csv("WomensTrack2025.csv")
```

```{r}
track <- track |> mutate(Discipline = if_else(Event %in% c(100, 200, 400), "Sprint", "Distance"))
```

```{r}
sprint <- track |> filter(Discipline == "Sprint")
distance <- track |> filter(Discipline == "Distance")

track <- track |> mutate(Event = as.factor(Event))

ggplot(sprint, aes(x = Event, y = Speed)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = Event))

test <- aov(Speed ~ as.factor(Event), data = distance)
summary(test)

tukey <- TukeyHSD(test)
tukey
```
